marketing.heroBody: Muhasib.ai is accounting software for UAE businesses and the firms that serve them. Issue bilingual tax invoices, reconcile bank statements, prepare your VAT 201 and run WPS payroll from one double-entry ledger.
marketing.heroNote: Free plan available · 14-day trial on paid plans · Prices in AED
marketing.productTitle: One ledger for everything a UAE finance desk does.
marketing.productBody: Invoices, bills, receipts, bank lines and payroll all post to the same double-entry ledger, so your reports, VAT return and payroll always agree with each other.
marketing.vatTitle: A VAT return you can explain, box by box.
marketing.vatBody: Each box is computed from the documents in your ledger: per-emirate supplies, reverse charge, imports and adjustments. The result is reconciled to your VAT control accounts, and an unexplained difference holds the return until someone reviews it.
marketing.vatPoint1: Boxes 1a to 14 from posted invoices, bills and receipts
marketing.vatPoint3: Excel workbook and FTA Audit File for your records
marketing.vatNote: Muhasib.ai prepares the return and its workbook. You submit it yourself on the FTA's EmaraTax portal.
marketing.invoiceBody: Issue English and Arabic tax invoices with your TRN and VAT breakdown, then share a PDF or a secure customer link.
marketing.invoicePoint1: Quotes, credit notes and recurring invoices
marketing.invoicePoint2: Customer portal for invoices and statements
marketing.bankBody: Import CSV or PDF statements from your bank, review suggested matches against invoices, bills and receipts, and post them with an approval step.
marketing.payrollBody: Run monthly payroll with allowances, deductions and leave. Approve it, post it to the ledger and generate the WPS SIF file to upload to your bank.
marketing.payrollPoint1: Calculate, approve and pay, with ledger postings
marketing.reportsBody: Profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance, cash flow and ageing from one reporting engine, exported to PDF or Excel.
marketing.firmsTitle: Run every client's books from one workspace.
marketing.firmsBody: See each client company's deadlines and open work in one list. VAT workpapers move from draft to prepared, reviewed and filed, and the preparer can never be the reviewer.
marketing.firmsPoint1Body: Every client company, its tasks and its compliance calendar in one place.
marketing.firmsPoint2Body: Workpapers record who prepared and who reviewed each return, with a locked history.
marketing.firmsPoint3Body: Staff, reviewers and client users see only what their role allows.
marketing.stepsTitle: From first login to a reviewed VAT return.
marketing.step1Body: Add your TRN and fiscal year, pick a UAE chart of accounts, and import opening balances and contacts from Excel or your previous system.
marketing.step2Body: Issue invoices, capture receipts, enter bills and import bank statements. Suggested matches keep the bank and the ledger in step.
marketing.step3Body: Close the month with a checklist, prepare the VAT 201, and export statements or an accountant pack whenever someone asks for them.
marketing.pricingTitle: Plans in AED, with a free plan to start.
marketing.pricingBody: Paid plans include a 14-day trial. Switch plans or cancel from your subscription settings.
marketing.planStarterSummary: 1 company, 3 users, bill pay and inventory
marketing.planEnterpriseSummary: Unlimited companies and users, API access
marketing.faqTitle: What people ask before they switch.
marketing.faq1Q: Does Muhasib.ai submit my VAT return to the FTA?
marketing.faq1A: No. Muhasib.ai prepares the VAT 201 from your ledger, reconciles it and exports the supporting workbook. You or your accountant submit the return on the FTA's EmaraTax portal.
marketing.faq2Q: Is the whole product available in Arabic?
marketing.faq2A: Yes. You can switch the interface between English and Arabic at any time, and invoices can carry both languages on the same document.
marketing.faq3Q: Can it connect to my bank directly?
marketing.faq3A: Not today. You import statements as CSV or PDF files exported from your online banking; Muhasib.ai then suggests matches for you to review.
marketing.faq4A: Muhasib.ai generates and validates PINT AE e-invoices. Sending them through the UAE network requires an accredited service provider, which is set up separately during onboarding.
marketing.faq5Q: Can my accountant work in the same books?
marketing.faq5A: Yes. Invite your accountant with the role that fits their work. Accounting firms can also manage all of their clients from the firm workspace.
marketing.faq6Q: How do I move from Excel, Zoho Books, Wafeq or mazeed?
marketing.faq6A: Our migration guides walk through the chart of accounts, opening balances, contacts and open invoices for each system.
marketing.faq7A: Access is role-based, traffic is encrypted in transit and changes are recorded in an audit trail. The Trust page describes our current controls and what is still on the roadmap.

marketing.ctaBody: Start on the free plan, import your opening balances, and see your first VAT 201 workbook built from your own data.
